free_tier.notes: Always Free resources are permanent for the life of the account in home region. No credit card required for free-only accounts.

paid_plan_baseline.notes: Upgrade optional; free-only accounts never charged automatically

tos_analysis.assignment_clause: Standard enterprise TOS — no resale/sublicensing without Oracle partner agreement
tos_analysis.commercial_use_restrictions: Direct resale of raw OCI capacity prohibited. However, building and selling managed applications/services ON TOP of free tier is standard practice (SaaS model).
key_risks: Cannot resell raw compute/storage as-is (no white-label IaaS rights)
Home region lock-in for Always Free resources
Capacity availability not guaranteed ('out of host capacity' errors possible)
Account suspension risk if usage patterns trigger fraud detection on free-only accounts
tos_analysis.viability_notes: Managed Setup Service model viable: agent provisions and manages OCI infrastructure for client's own application deployment. Client owns tenancy; agent charges for setup, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance. Similar to Clerk Auth pattern.

reselling_model.description: Agent creates/manages OCI Always Free tenancy for client. Deploys client apps on free ARM/AMD instances. Charges one-time setup fee + optional monthly management retainer. Client pays $0 to Oracle directly.
revenue_streams: Setup fee: $50-200 per tenancy provisioning + app deployment
Monthly management: $20-50/mo for monitoring, updates, backups
Migration services: $100-500 for moving existing workloads to OCI free tier

next_steps: Create PoC: automated OCI tenancy setup script using OCI CLI/API
Document standard deployment templates (Node.js, Python, static sites)
Build monitoring/alerting stack within free tier limits
Validate TOS for managed service wrapper via Oracle Partner Network docs
alternatives_compared: AWS Free Tier (12-month trial only, not permanent)
GCP Free Tier ($300 credits + limited always-free, less generous than OCI)
verification_method: web.archive.org snapshot of OCI Always Free Resources documentation (live site returned 403)
